openingMessage: The field doesn't care how your morning started. It cares whether you're ready. Let's make sure we are.
openingWhy: H2S doesn't know you slept bad, fought with the house, or that the truck's AC quit. A hundred ppm at the hatch is a hundred ppm. The gas shows up ready every single day. The only question on the table is whether you do.
leadershipThought: 100% tie-off means one hook is always in before the other comes off. Not almost always. Always. Standards don't soften because the job is routine — the routine job is where standards get skipped.
